decision.title: Explicit null on optional write arguments
decision.question: When a caller passes null for an optional write argument (updateOrder note; createOrder payment and item unitPriceCents), should the connector omit the key or send JSON null?
decision.context: Recommendation: omit. The spec does not say null clears a field, and every optional write member is nullable-by-omission only.

choices.label: Send null (lets a caller clear updateOrder note)
